checks.evidence: Test 1 verifies the Staff Responsible remaining distance (supervised distance minus distance travelled, corrected by under-reading for max safe front end). It has no step where the SR distance has been covered, the driver requests an extension, the RBC grants a new SR distance, and supervision restarts. It also has no Level 2 context and no target distance display.

invented: Specific values (100 m SR distance, 2 m under-reading, 3 m over-reading) are fixed in the preconditions, not stated as assumptions
The expected remaining distance from the min safe front end (distance + over-reading) is given, a formula the requirement does not state explicitly
Negative remaining distance values in the zero-distance test (e.g. -2 m, -7 m) are presented without justification
